credit.credit-words: My Home Is on the Rock
WORDS: Johnson Oatman, Jr., pub.1896. MUSIC: Adam Geibel, pub.1896. Public Domain.

Whosoever... heareth my sayings, and doeth them... is like a man which built an house... and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream... could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock. Lk. 6:47-48
